data.text:
Smt. Pratima Basu vs Food Safety & Standard Authority Of ... on 
10 December, 2024 
Author: Suvra Ghosh
Bench: Suvra Ghosh
December 10, 2024 167 Ardr Crr 5166 of 2024 Smt. Pratima Basu Vs. Food Safety & Standard 
Authority of India Adv. Tridib Bose, Adv. Sourav Roy ....for the petitioner. 
The petitioner who claims to be the erstwhile director of M/s. Switz Food Private Limited seeks
quashing of proceedings being Ac case no. 2827 of 2023 pending before the learned Additional
Chief Judicial Magistrate, Alipore. 
The petitioner produces an order of this Court passed on 9th December, 2024 in CRR 3889 of 2024 whereby further proceedings of AC case no. 2827 of 2023 pending before the learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Alipore has been stayed till 31st January, 2025 or until further orders,
whichever is earlier. In view of the above, the petitioner is directed to serve copy of the application along with annexure thereto upon the opposite party and file affidavit of service on the adjourned date. Let the matter appear under the same heading on 9th January, 2025. 
(Suvra Ghosh, J.)
